title: Slow Cooker Pulled Pork
description: Pork shoulder seared, then slow-cooked in a tangy homemade sauce of cider vinegar, ketchup, molasses and brown sugar, and shredded for sandwiches.

ingredients.note: ½ tsp for the pork, 1 tsp for the sauce

steps.heading: Stir the Sauce
steps.text: Mix the onion, vinegar, ketchup, chili sauce, brown sugar, molasses, Worcestershire, dry mustard and 1 tsp pepper in a bowl.

steps.heading: Sear the Pork
steps.text: Season the pork halves with the salt and ½ tsp pepper and brown them well on every side in a hot skillet.

steps.heading: Slow Cook
steps.text: Put the pork in a 6-quart slow cooker, pour the sauce over and cook on low 8 to 10 hours (or high 5 to 6) until it falls apart. Give it another hour if it's still firm.

steps.heading: Skim
steps.text: Lift out the pork and pull off any big pieces of fat. Skim the fat from the cooking liquid, and strain it if you like.

steps.heading: Shred
steps.text: Pull the meat apart with two forks, put it back in the cooker and stir in liquid until it's as saucy as you want.

steps.heading: Serve
steps.text: Pile onto buns, with extra barbecue sauce if you like.
